name: app-white-on-white-neumorphic-nft-shopping-app-screens
title: White-on-White NFT Shopping Screens
whatItIs: Two nearly all-white phone screens with faint topographic line texture: a collectibles home with category pills, rarity levels and a circular artwork slot above a name and score, and an NFT Art list with owner and creator chips, price, View history and Buy Now.
whatItMeans: Tone-on-tone white gives a soft, tactile calm, and tiny black details do the work of hierarchy.
techniques: White on white with soft raised shadows
Black pill as the only strong selected state
Rarity stats placed at the card corners
Circular artwork slot as the focal point

vocabulary.definition: Using near-identical values so structure comes from shadow and contrast.
A score showing how scarce a collectible is.
Contour-map lines used as a subtle background.
